goal: A player must accumulate more points than the other player, which means at least 61 points.
total: There are in total 40 cards and 120 points available distributed across the cards.
card: Each card has a suit type and a rank. The rank determines how many points the card has.
start:
1. The game starts by selecting one special card called "Briscola" which determines what is the dominant suit and each player gets 3 cards.
The briscola is then placed under the deck and it is visible for the rest of the game.
turnSystem: 2. The first player plays one card then the other player plays one card (it's not mandatory to follow suit).
turnEnd: 3. The winner of the trick is the highest rank card of the suit played by the first player or the highest rank "briscola" card.
tricks: 4. The winner takes the card in the tricks pile and then each player draws one card from the deck.
decide: 5. The winner of the trick plays first in the next round.
end: The game ends when there are no more cards left to play.
